testing_state: Slingy Spider is on Google Play's INTERNAL testing track. The closed test - the one that needs 12 testers opted in for 14 continuous days before the game can leave testing - has not started yet.
join_steps: Check which Google account your phone's Play Store is signed in to. Use that same account for every step below - this is the one that catches almost everyone.
Join the Google Group linked in #start-here.
Wait a little while for the group membership to propagate, then open the opt-in page signed in to that same account and tap 'Become a tester'.
Install from the Play link the opt-in page shows you.
Post 'opted in' in #general. Menno checks the Play Console and hands out the Slingy Tester role by hand - it is never automatic.

troubleshooting.symptom: 'App not available' on the Play page
troubleshooting.fix: Almost always the wrong Google account, or the group join has not propagated yet. Check the account first, then give it a while and try again.

troubleshooting.symptom: The opt-in page does not show a tester option
troubleshooting.fix: You are probably signed in as a different account than the Play Store uses. Sign out and back in with the Play Store's account.

facts.name: How it plays
facts.value: You are a small spider in an oversized world. Fire a line of silk, swing, and turn speed into momentum - release at the right moment and fly. Swinging is the whole game; everything else exists to make it feel good.

facts.name: Finding the flow
facts.value: Good timing chains swings into faster, cleaner movement. Accelerate through the low point, ease toward the apex, release, and arc.

facts.name: Reel
facts.value: Reel in your silk line to tighten a curve. It costs energy, so spend it where it counts.

facts.name: The bird
facts.value: A pursuing bird enforces pace. It is what used to be a kill line on the left of the screen, made visible.

facts.name: Fairness
facts.value: Obstacle layouts are seeded and fair, not random chaos - the same course rewards the same skill. Deaths are meant to be understandable, never arbitrary.

facts.name: Flies and upgrades
facts.value: Catch flies mid-arc with the same silk you move with, and spend earnings on spiders and upgrades that trade one strength for another. Nothing sells power over other players.

facts.name: Run History
facts.value: Home -> Play Modes -> Run History shows your last runs and lifetime totals, and COPY JSON exports them. Nothing is ever uploaded from the game; the export is yours to paste if you want a report to carry real numbers.

feedback_wanted: Where the difficulty spikes, and roughly how far in - the game is still being tuned for exactly this.
Whether a death felt understandable or arbitrary.
Whether the Reel and the release timing feel like they answer you.
Anything that made you stop playing.
retention_rules: Do not leave the Google Group.
Do not uninstall during the test.
Play a few times a week - Google checks real engagement, and the 14 days have to be continuous.
